title: What is Code-First vs Database-First in Entity Framework Core?
description: Understand the different EF Core development approaches.

data.text: **Question:** What is Code-First vs Database-First in Entity Framework Core?
Code-First creates the database from your C# classes and migrations. Database-First reverse-engineers an existing database into C# classes. EF Core supports both approaches with different tools.

**Code-First Approach:**
- Write C# entity classes first
- Use migrations to create/update database
- Database schema evolves with code
- Preferred for new projects
- Full control over schema
- Migrations track schema changes

**Database-First Approach:**
- Start with existing database
- Use Scaffold-DbContext to generate classes
- Database is the source of truth
- Good for legacy databases
- Requires re-scaffolding on schema changes

**Model-First (less common):**
- Design model visually
- Generate database and classes from model
- More common in EF6 than EF Core
- Not officially supported in EF Core
